subject: general
question: Which of the following is a Zaid crop?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muskmelon.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Zaid crops are **small time period crops** that are also referred to as **summer crops **and as **"Grishmkal crops**" in various** Asian regions.**
 
• These are planted from** March to June, **in the period between the Kharif and Rabi seasons.
 
• They need l**onger days for blossoming** and** warm, dry weather** for their **critical growth stage**.
 
• This is** important for farmers** because it provides them with **quick cash** and** fills the gap** between their two main crops, Kharif and Rabi.
 
• **Examples** include cucumbers, pumpkins, bitter gourd, watermelons, muskmelons, sugarcane, groundnuts, and pulses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rabi Crops:**

 
 
• Rabi crops are those that are** cultivated** during the** winter months (October to December) **and **harvested **during the **spring months (April to May).**
 
• These crops require a** warm climate for germination and maturation** of seeds and need a** cold environment for their growth.**
 
• **Winter rain damages the Rabi crop** but benefits the Kharif crop.
 
• Wheat, gram, barley, peas, oats, chickpeas, linseed, mustard, etc. are a few **examples.**
 
 
 
• **​Kharif Crops:**
 
 
• The monsoon season is when crops called **Kharif, monsoon crops, or autumn crops** are grown and harvested.
 
• At the start of the** monsoon season**, the farmer **plants seeds, **and at the end of the season, he **harvests them** i.e., between **September and October.**
 
• For** effective growth,** Kharif crops require a** lot of water and a warm climate.**
 
• **Examples** include cotton, rice, maize, millet, soybeans, and arhar.​
